body:
Hi team, I notice reading from hive partitioned parquets doesn't always get the correct type; for example
```sql
memory D COPY (
             SELECT TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 12:30:00' AS ts, TIME '12:30:00' AS t, DATE '2024-01-01' AS d, 1 AS v
         ) TO '/tmp/hive_repro' (FORMAT parquet, PARTITION_BY (ts, t, d));
memory D SELECT typeof(ts), typeof(t), typeof(d)
         FROM read_parquet('/tmp/hive_repro/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning = true);
┌────────────┬───────────┬───────────┐
│ typeof(ts) │ typeof(t) │ typeof(d) │
│  varchar   │  varchar  │  varchar  │
├────────────┼───────────┼───────────┤
│ VARCHAR    │ VARCHAR   │ DATE      │
└────────────┴───────────┴───────────┘
```
I think the root cause is
- Hive partition type detection cast the raw, URL-encoded directory value, so TIMESTAMP partitions written by DuckDB were read back as VARCHAR
- Detection now unescapes the value before trying the candidate casts, as In the [`HivePartitioning::GetValue`](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/b54bafed481c85bf170006a30004c60394eeab80/src/common/hive_partitioning.cpp#L171) already does when reading
title: Detect hive partition types from unescaped values
